subject: GatewayOne portal: evidence intake & SSO onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Li <security@alphasystems.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GatewayOne portal: Redwood evidence intake and SSO checklist

Hi Jonas / Markus,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We're kicking off the OneTrust/Whistic onboarding for GatewayOne and want to set clear acceptance criteria so your profile goes live without multiple rounds of upload. At a high level we need:

- A scoped SIG/CAIQ inventory (top-40 mapping) so we don't surface everything at once.
- Proof-of-possession for the SOC 2 report (redacted PDF) and the KMS key rotation statement.
- SSO proof (SAML metadata or a successful test assertion) + the IDP contact.
- Minimal syslog sample (first and last 24 hours) for ingestion/format check.

I've attached the OneTrust portal invite (gatewayone_onetrust_invite.html) and a small syslog sample we use as an example.

Target: if we get the scoped CAIQ matrix + SOC 2 redacted by next Wednesday (2026-09-29) we can complete verification the following week.

Questions / asks: can Redwood accept a scoped SIG extract instead of the full CAIQ? Also confirm whether you prefer us to upload items into the portal on your behalf or provide a signed manifest for transfer.

Cheers,
Samantha Li
Senior Security Operations
GatewayOne

Attachments: gatewayone_onetrust_invite.html (text/html), gatewayone_syslog_sample.txt (text/plain)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <security@alphasystems.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GatewayOne portal: Redwood evidence intake and SSO checklist

Hi Samantha — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) Scoped SIG extract: yes, we can produce a trimmed SIG/CAIQ mapping limited to control families you care about (authn, encryption, logging, incident mgmt). We usually deliver the top-40 mapping as an XLSX with a column that points to the actual evidence file names.

2) SOC 2: we will provide a redacted PDF proof-of-possession plus an ownership statement signed by our Compliance Manager; happy to upload into the portal if you share a shared-upload link (preferred) or we can hand off to your intake team.

3) SSO: our SAML metadata is ready — Markus can confirm the IDP test window. For the metadata proof, we can either execute a test assertion (recommended) or drop the metadata XML.

4) Syslog sample: we will sanitize and provide a 48-hour sample compressed; please confirm acceptable fields (we will strip PII).

Next steps I propose:
- Markus to confirm SAML test availability and whether you want Redwood to upload files.
- I will prepare the scoped CAIQ matrix and SOC redacted; target deliverable 2026-09-29 EOD.

If that timeline looks good, we'll queue the artifacts and ping you once uploads are complete.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <security@alphasystems.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GatewayOne portal: Redwood evidence intake and SSO checklist

Samantha — quick note from infra:

- We can run an IDP test Tuesday 2026-09-28 between 10:00–13:00 PDT. Jonas, please lock that if that works for GatewayOne.
- For evidence uploads: please send the OneTrust upload token (we prefer to let your portal intake team accept items to avoid duplicate copies). If you need us to upload, we'll follow your manifest naming convention.
- SOC 2 redacted: we will provide the redacted PDF and a short attestation (signed). Expect the syslog sample and CAIQ extract in a single archive (gatewayone_syslog_sample.txt will be replaced with a sanitized file).

I propose we keep the scope to SOC 2 + top-40 CAIQ for the first pass; we can follow up with full SIG if the vendor review team requests deeper coverage. That keeps verification faster.

Markus Klein
Head of Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

- Upload: please use the OneTrust assignment link below; our intake team will move items into the verification queue. If you prefer Redwood to upload, reply with a short manifest CSV and we will provide a secure upload token.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting you live.

Best,
